title: Get a permit for an advertising sign in a public place
what: Get the council's permit before putting an advertising sign or bill on a road, footpath, council property or other public place.

confidence_note: Quotes the local law as made, from the WA Government Gazette; WA publishes no consolidated local laws. The clause was found by a pattern search of every Gazette from 1996 to 2026 (E-8), and the law was taken as in force because no later repeal naming it was found. The council adopted the Kojonup local law with modifications (Gazette No. 223, 9 Nov 2001); the clause is quoted from that law as made. The adopting law modifies this clause, so the quoted words may differ. Amended later (Gazette No. 178, 17 Oct 2008, Gazette No. 187, 8 Oct 2010); the amendments were not read. The council adopted the York local law with modifications (Gazette No. 57, 11 Apr 2008); the clause is quoted from that law as made. The adopting law modifies this clause, so the quoted words may differ.

assessment.summary: Advertising signs in public places need the council's permit.
